summary: Frontend-only regression run executed for mobile/tablet Play Movie behavior with mocked Android bridge and delayed stream fixtures. Unit tests for device classification and movie play intent pass (15/15). Mobile autoplay tap triggers native handoff payload correctly, but rapid repeated taps caused duplicate native launches in mocked bridge flow.

ui_bugs.issue: Rapid repeat taps on [data-testid='detail-play-autoplay'] triggered multiple native handoffs (expected single launch per request window).

integration_issues.issue: Bridge payload validation passed for title/cwId/alternatives on first tap, but duplicate launches were observed on repeated taps before CTA state prevented subsequent actions.

MOCKED limitation: browser automation context here does not enable hasTouch; page.touchscreen.tap is unavailable. Used synthetic touchstart/touchend + click fallback with Android WebView UA/bridge mock to continue regression.

action_items: Debounce/lock detail-play-autoplay after first manual launch request so rapid taps cannot call Host.playVideo multiple times.
Keep manual tap idempotent until title key or candidate set changes (not just a 500 ms guard window).
Re-run tablet-wide and autoplay-off swap-stream interaction after duplicate-launch fix; current run stopped additional playwright selector iterations per loop-prevention rule.
If strict 'real CDP touch' is mandatory, run in a Playwright context configured with hasTouch=true/mobile emulation; current harness cannot provide that capability.
critical_code_review_comments: useMoviePlayIntent currently suppresses duplicates only for ~500ms via performance.now; this is too short for repeated user taps while Detail remains interactive.
Detail CTA remains tap-enabled immediately after first native handoff request; there is no explicit in-flight launch lock tied to titleKey/candidate state.
Good fix already present: deviceInput strips OnNowTV UA suffix and classifies Android touch devices as handheld, with TV-family UA hard exclusions maintained.
seed_data_creation: No backend seed/user mutation. Test session used existing testuser/testpass123 and local profile keys for gated-route bootstrap.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Executed frontend-only run on external URL with mocked OnNowTV bridge. Unit regressions added and passing: isHandheldInput + useMoviePlayIntent (15 tests). Mobile flow confirmed first native play payload includes expected title 'The Matrix', cwId 'tt0133093', and non-empty streamsJSON alternatives. Rapid duplicate taps reproduced multiple handoffs (HIGH). Prior attempts hit login gate and no-touch context limitations; see console logs for sequence.
rca of the issue: Repro: on mobile viewport (390x844), open /title/movie/tt0133093?autoplay=1, tap [detail-play-autoplay] once (native handoff captured), then rapidly tap 3 more times. Observed additional bridge invocations. Likely cause: useMoviePlayIntent dedupe is time-window based (500ms) and CTA remains actionable after first launch, so repeated manual calls can re-trigger Host.playVideo. Mitigation: add deterministic one-shot guard per title/candidate launch cycle (e.g., explicit launched flag reset only on titleKey change or stream-pick reset), and disable CTA while launch dispatch is pending/just sent.
